explain.title: Why this prediction

explainQuality.title: Explanation quality
explainQuality.subtitle: How faithful and stable each model's attributions are, what drives it, and whether generated narration survives its audit.
explainQuality.noModels: No models registered yet. Train one from the model registry.
explainQuality.refreshQueued: Recompute queued; the numbers update in a few seconds.
explainQuality.noMetrics: No quality metrics for this model yet. Press Recompute to calculate them from its bundle.
explainQuality.pdp: Partial dependence of the top features
explainQuality.noPdp: No partial dependence computed yet. Press Recompute.
explainQuality.passRateHelp: Narrations whose LLM wording passed rank, sign, numeric and vocabulary checks
explainQuality.noAudits: No narrations have been audited for this model yet.
explainQuality.auditNote: A failed audit is not an outage: the deterministic template text is shown instead.
explainQuality.llmOff: LLM paraphrasing is off, so there is nothing to audit.
explainQuality.llmOffDetail: Every narration shown is the deterministic template built directly from the attributions. Set TV_LLM_ENDPOINT to have an LLM rephrase it; each paraphrase is then audited here before it is shown.

deletion_auc.label: Deletion AUC
deletion_auc.help: Remove the most important features first: a faithful explanation makes the prediction collapse quickly. 0 is ideal.

insertion_auc.label: Insertion AUC
insertion_auc.help: Add the most important features back first: a faithful explanation recovers the prediction quickly. 1 is ideal.

pgi.label: Prediction gap (important)
pgi.help: How far the prediction moves when the top three features are perturbed by 10%.

sensitivity_max.label: Max sensitivity
sensitivity_max.help: Worst-case change of the attributions under a 5% input perturbation. Lower means a steadier explanation.

sparsity.label: Sparsity
sparsity.help: Share of features carrying almost no attribution. Higher means a shorter, more readable explanation.

truth_top1_agreement.label: Truth top-1 agreement
truth_top1_agreement.help: On simulated data the true driver is known: how often it is ranked first.

window_jaccard.label: Window stability
window_jaccard.help: Top-3 feature overlap between consecutive live explanations of the same machine.
